sources.title: ICON atmosphere documentation
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: OpenFOAM：邊界通量符號與連續性殘差
related.titleEn: OpenFOAM: boundary-flux signs and continuity residuals
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：常數保持、合法權重及總量核對共同構成最小驗收。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Constant preservation, valid weights and mass reconciliation form the minimum acceptance evidence.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「OpenFOAM：邊界通量符號與連續性殘差」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付邊界方向圖、分項通量表、局部與全域殘差及完整連續性假設。
related.differenceEn: Investigate OpenFOAM: boundary-flux signs and continuity residuals using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver a boundary-orientation map, individual flux entries, local and global residuals and the complete continuity assumptions supporting the chosen acceptance criterion.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 計算 0.02 與 0.06 kg，再除總空氣質量五；用總示蹤物反推平均作交叉檢查。
將正值與負值絕對量分組，再計淨值；同時算總絕對通量以說明不同診斷代表不同量。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute tracer masses 0.02 and 0.06 kg and divide their sum by five kilograms of air. Reconstruct total tracer mass from the resulting mean to check that no weighting factor disappeared.

Group inflows and outflow magnitudes, then compute their difference. Also calculate absolute throughput and explain why absolute flux, net flux and local continuity errors are different diagnostics rather than interchangeable totals.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Trilinos Belos：GMRES 重啟基底與收斂成本
related.titleEn: Trilinos Belos: GMRES restart bases and convergence cost
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：常數保持、合法權重及總量核對共同構成最小驗收。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Constant preservation, valid weights and mass reconciliation form the minimum acceptance evidence.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「Trilinos Belos：GMRES 重啟基底與收斂成本」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付基底容量帳本、重啟點殘差圖、正交性測試與時間到解比較。
related.differenceEn: Investigate Trilinos Belos: GMRES restart bases and convergence cost using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver basis-capacity ledgers, residual histories marked at restart boundaries, orthogonality tests and time-to-solution comparisons under an unchanged mathematical problem.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 計算 0.02 與 0.06 kg，再除總空氣質量五；用總示蹤物反推平均作交叉檢查。
算單向量八十萬 bytes，再乘二十一；將 MB 與 MiB 區別並禁止省略額外向量。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute tracer masses 0.02 and 0.06 kg and divide their sum by five kilograms of air. Reconstruct total tracer mass from the resulting mean to check that no weighting factor disappeared.

Compute eight hundred thousand bytes per vector and multiply by twenty-one. Distinguish decimal MB from binary MiB and retain the additional Arnoldi vector, which is easily omitted in informal estimates.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
